brand.oneLiner: Opatija's 1971 seafront restaurant with a 10-room five-star boutique hotel and Amore Sea Club.

audiences.name: Wine and seafood hedonists
audiences.description: Domestic and foreign food lovers drawn by Kvarner scampi, dry-aged steaks, 750+ wine labels and sommelier Klaudio Jurčić, plus Rijeka professionals dining out.

audiences.name: Intimate wedding and corporate planners

usps: First five-star boutique hotel in the northern Adriatic, just 10 sea-view rooms
Restaurant open since 1971 with 750+ wine labels curated by Klaudio Jurčić
Ten rooms named after famous Opatija guests, from James Joyce to Puccini
Own 70-metre riva with free SUPs and kayaks and Amore Sea Club
opportunities: TripAdvisor sits at 3.9 while Booking scores 9.4. A post-visit review flow plus prompt, personal owner replies to price and service complaints would close the gap.
No social links on the website and a quiet Instagram. Reels around 'Who slept in your room?', the Joyce and Puccini suites, would turn the room-naming story into content.
Build an off-season wine programme: Klaudio Jurčić cellar dinners and Dom Pérignon evenings with a room package, pushed via Meta ads to Zagreb, Ljubljana and Vienna for November–March.

seo.summary: Bevanda has a strong story (restaurant since 1971, 10 named sea-view rooms, 750+ wines), but the site hides it from search with six H1s, no structured data, no canonical tags and no social previews. The bigger wins are local: conflicting opening hours across listings, a 3.9 TripAdvisor score, and HR/EN/DE pages that are not connected for DACH and Italian guests.

recommendations.issue: Opening hours conflict across Google, TripAdvisor, Falstaff and VisitOpatija
recommendations.fix: Claim separate Google Business Profiles for Hotel Bevanda, Restoran Bevanda and Amore Sea Club. Set one official schedule and sync it to TripAdvisor, Falstaff, OpenTable and VisitOpatija this week.

recommendations.issue: No Schema.org structured data on any page
recommendations.fix: Add Hotel and Restaurant JSON-LD with Zert 8 address, +385 51 493 888, openingHours, servesCuisine 'Seafood, Mediterranean', priceRange, hasMenu and aggregateRating linked to Booking reviews.

recommendations.issue: HR/EN/DE versions not linked with hreflang tags
recommendations.fix: Add hreflang hr, en, de and x-default to every page so German and Austrian guests land on the DE version. Add an Italian version for Trieste and Friuli guests.

recommendations.issue: Weddings, wine cellar and Kvarner scampi have no landing pages
recommendations.fix: Create EN and DE pages for 'Wedding venue Opatija', 'Wine cellar with sommelier Klaudio Jurčić' and 'Kvarner scampi and dry-aged steaks', each with photos, a menu excerpt and an inquiry form.

recommendations.issue: Six H1s, no canonical, no Open Graph tags
recommendations.fix: Use one H1 per page, e.g. 'Bevanda Opatija – 5-star boutique hotel & restaurant since 1971', and demote the rest to H2. Add self-referencing canonicals and og:image, using a terrace sunset photo.

plan.strategy: With Amore Sea Club quiet for winter, these two weeks shift Bevanda's story from the riva to the cellar, the kitchen and the suites. Martinje on 11 November anchors a wine push led by Klaudio Jurčić, while the 'Who slept in your room?' series turns the Joyce and Puccini suites into reasons for November weekend breaks from Zagreb, Ljubljana and Vienna. In the final days we start Christmas voucher sales and 2027 small-wedding inquiries.

posts.hook: James Joyce stayed in Opatija. Tonight, so do you.
posts.caption:
Ten rooms. Ten names from Opatija's guest list. 📜

James Joyce. Giacomo Puccini. Writers, composers, aristocrats: they all chose this coast.

At Bevanda, every room carries one of their names. The Joyce and Puccini Deluxe Suites come with a private terrace, a jacuzzi facing the Kvarner Bay and a king-size bed you won't want to leave. 🌊

Breakfast is à la carte, from a kitchen that has been cooking since 1971.

Which name would you sleep under?
posts.visualIdea: POV: hand opens door marked 'James Joyce', slow pan to jacuzzi with sea view, text overlays name each famous guest. Ends on the terrace at sunset. 15–20 seconds, piano score.
posts.cta: Book the Joyce or Puccini Suite via the link in bio.

posts.hook: 750 wine labels. One man knows every bottle.
posts.caption:
Swipe through Klaudio Jurčić's cellar. 🍷

1️⃣ 750+ labels, from rare vintages to hidden Croatian gems
2️⃣ Kvarner scampi, the Adriatic's sweetest bite
3️⃣ Dry-aged meat sizzling on black-rock volcanic stone
4️⃣ Istrian truffles for the earthy end of the table
5️⃣ Dom Pérignon, because we're proud ambassadors 🥂

One of Croatia's finest sommeliers, a glass-walled dining room facing the lights of Rijeka, and a story that started in 1971.

Tell Klaudio what you're eating. He'll do the rest.
posts.visualIdea: Six slides: Klaudio portrait in the cellar, then close-ups of scampi, a steak on volcanic stone, truffle shaving and a Dom Pérignon pour. Final slide: glass dining room at blue hour.
posts.cta: Reserve your table at bevanda.hr or call +385 51 493 888.

posts.hook: No dress code. No reservations. Just the riva at sunset.
posts.caption:
Same address, new story: Amore Sea Club. 🌅

Right on Bevanda's own 70-metre riva in Opatija:
☕ morning coffee facing the Kvarner
🥗 a light snack when the sun gets serious
🥂 wine and bubbles under the moon

New this season: Wine&Cork, a corner dedicated to good bottles and good company.

Amore isn't exclusive. Come in flip-flops, come straight from work in Rijeka, come with the whole gang. No pomp, just the sea and a perfect glass. 🍷

See you on the riva?
posts.visualIdea: Drone shot of the 70-metre riva at golden hour. Lead image: two glasses of sparkling wine on a table at the water's edge, waves and the Kvarner horizon behind.
posts.cta: Drop by tonight at Zert 8, Opatija, and tag who's coming with you.

ads.headline: Sleep in James Joyce's Suite
ads.primaryText: James Joyce and Giacomo Puccini both chose Opatija. Today our two Deluxe Suites carry their names: a jacuzzi facing Kvarner Bay, a private terrace and a king-size bed. Bevanda has just 10 rooms and was the first five-star boutique hotel in the northern Adriatic. Breakfast comes from a kitchen that has been cooking since 1971.
ads.description: Jacuzzi suites, private terraces, free SUPs and kayaks on our own 70 m riva.
ads.audience: Couples aged 35–65 in Vienna, Munich, Ljubljana and Trieste, interested in luxury travel, boutique hotels and anniversaries. Exclude people who have booked in the last 180 days.
ads.budgetTip: Run a carousel of the Joyce and Puccini suites at €25/day, then move spend to the winner after 5 days.

ads.headline: 750 Wines. One Table Over Kvarner.
ads.primaryText: Kvarner scampi, sweet and straight from the bay. Dry-aged steaks sizzling on volcanic black rock. Istrian truffles. Then there's a cellar of 750+ labels kept by sommelier Klaudio Jurčić, one of Croatia's best. Bevanda has been doing this since 1971. Book a table by the glass wall and stay for the lights of Rijeka.
ads.description: Seafront restaurant since 1971. Falstaff 89 points. Dom Pérignon ambassador.
ads.audience: Ages 30–65 within 150 km (Rijeka, Zagreb, Ljubljana), interested in fine dining, wine and gourmet food, plus tourists currently in Kvarner.
ads.budgetTip: Spend €15/day, raise it Thursday to Saturday, and run 7pm–9pm placements for travellers already in Opatija.
